verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents API versioning: Version 2 is the default, versions are selected per request via the X-Cerebras-Version-Patch header, and a "What's Guaranteed" section promises breaking changes only in new versions. A dated deprecations log covers models and parameters, with migration guidance and effective dates, alongside a changelog. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the versioning and deprecation commitments are honored in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Cerebras uses API versioning to manage breaking changes to request validation and response formats. Version 2 is now the default for API requests.
Breaking changes only happen in new API versions, giving you time to test and migrate.
A list of all deprecations, with the most recent announcements appearing first.
